name: gains
title: Gains
description: What was gained or lost, realized and unrealized, over a window (default: the last twelve months). view=summary: one row: realized, unrealized at the start and end, change, gain = realized + change, share of value with a cost basis. sources, portfolios, accounts: the same per entity; they add up to the summary. positions: per account and holding. realized: each lot sold, as the tax document or statement states it or the lot engine rebuilt it. lots: the open lots at the window's end. coverage: per account, where the figures are blind. check: the lot engine against the stated lots and cost bases. quality names every gap. Example: {view: "realized", from: "2025", to: "2025"}.

account.description: Keep rows whose account name, id or nickname contains this (case-insensitive).

asset_class.description: positions only: keep only this asset class (e.g. public_equity, fixed_income, private_equity).

currency.description: Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.

documents.description: realized only: each sale once (primary, default) or every document's copy (all).

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

from.description: Window start; snaps to the unit's start.

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

missing_basis.description: Not on coverage and check: a missing cost basis is blank (ignore, the default) or counts as 0 (zero; quality then says basis_assumed_zero=N); the config's lots.missing_basis sets the default.

newest_first.description: realized only: newest first (default false: oldest first).

period.description: Bucket size on summary, sources, portfolios, accounts (default total: one row for the whole window).

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

source.description: Keep this source id only (e.g. "schwab"); a comma list keeps several.

symbol.description: positions, realized and lots: keep only rows whose symbol or name contains this text.

tax_wrapper.description: accounts and coverage: keep only this tax wrapper (e.g. taxable_joint, roth_ira).

term.description: realized and lots: short or long.

to.description: Window end; snaps to the unit's end. Default today unless the tool says otherwise.
